acceptance: Every example installs a uv version >= 0.13.4 and puts it on PATH correctly
The GitHub Actions example uses astral-sh/setup-uv
description: `docs/advanced/ci-cd-integration.md` installs uv with `curl -LsSf https://astral.sh/uv/install.sh | sh` in every example and, in the GitLab, Jenkins and CircleCI examples, then runs `export PATH="$HOME/.cargo/bin:$PATH"`. Current uv installers put the binary in `~/.local/bin`, so the PATH line no longer finds it. The GitHub Actions example should use `astral-sh/setup-uv` like the repository's own workflows, and the other examples should pin a uv version at or above 0.13.4 (older uv trusts the compromised eMudhra emSign CAs) and add the correct directory to PATH.
